component.name: Unofficial Twitch Client
component.summary: Watch Twitch with notifications and lower delay

description.p: A desktop Twitch app with live notifications, lower delay, stream saving and ad blocking.

ul.li: Followed channels and subscriptions in the sidebar
Notifications when channels you follow go live
Full chat with emotes, polls and predictions
Behind-live counter with jump to live
Save live streams and download past broadcasts

description.p: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Twitch Interactive, Inc.
